conditions:
First interaction after defeating [[Kuudra]]
(Can appear as [[Abiphone]] dialogue)
wiki_group.extracted_text:
[NPC] Dean: Hello <player>?
[NPC] Dean: You found who stole our Sulphur?
[NPC] Dean: A giant magma creature with massive tentacles?

[NPC] Dean: I will call you later!

[NPC] Dean: Thank you very much you are a life savior, quite literally.
